#### **Shop Suitcases at David Jones**

Discover premium suitcases and luggage at David Jones, featuring trusted travel brands designed for every journey. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, business trip or international holiday, explore a range of luggage that combines durability, functionality and modern design. Shop leading brands including Samsonite, Antler and Delsey, with options designed to help you travel with confidence, stay organised and make the most of every adventure.

#### **Suitcases for Every Journey**

The right suitcase can make travelling easier, whether you're heading interstate for a short break or embarking on an overseas holiday. Explore luggage designed for different travel styles and trip lengths, with practical features that support organised packing and hassle-free travel. From lightweight options for frequent flyers to durable designs built for longer journeys, discover suitcases tailored to your travel needs.

#### **Hard Suitcases & Lightweight Luggage**

Shop [hard suitcases](https://www.davidjones.com/luggage-travel/suitcases/hard-shell), lightweight luggage and travel suitcases designed to withstand the demands of modern travel. Durable outer shells help protect your belongings, while lightweight materials make it easier to navigate airports, hotels and city streets. Many styles also feature smooth-glide wheels, organised interiors and expandable storage to help maximise packing capacity.

#### **Popular Suitcase Features**

Modern luggage is designed to deliver convenience and performance throughout every journey. Explore suitcases featuring:

- Lightweight construction
- Expandable compartments
- Smooth spinner wheels
- Organised internal storage
- Durable hard-shell designs
- Secure locking systems
- Cabin-friendly sizing on selected styles

These practical features can help make packing, transporting and accessing your belongings easier wherever you travel.

#### **Shop Leading Suitcase Brands**

Discover suitcases from some of the world's most trusted luggage brands. [Samsonite suitcases](https://www.davidjones.com/brand/samsonite/suitcases), [Antler suitcases](https://www.davidjones.com/brand/antler/suitcases), [American Tourister suitcases](https://www.davidjones.com/brand/american-tourister/suitcases) and [Delsey suitcases](https://www.davidjones.com/brand/delsey/suitcases) are renowned for quality craftsmanship, innovative design and reliable performance. Whether you're searching for lightweight luggage, durable hard suitcases or premium travel solutions, find luggage designed to support both frequent travel and occasional holidays.

#### **How to Choose the Right Suitcase**

When selecting a suitcase, consider how often you travel, the length of your trips and your preferred packing style. Lightweight luggage can help maximise baggage allowances, while hard suitcases provide additional protection for your belongings. Features such as expandable compartments, spinner wheels and organised interiors can also enhance convenience and travelling comfort.

#### **Complete Your Travel Setup**

Complete your journey with products designed to complement your luggage. Explore:

- Carry-On Luggage
- Travel Accessories
- Weekend & Overnight Bags
- Backpacks
- Laptop Bags

Together, these travel essentials can help create a more organised and seamless travel experience.

#### **Suitcase FAQs**

**What size suitcase should I choose?**

The right suitcase size depends on your destination, trip length and travel style. Smaller luggage is often suitable for short stays, while larger suitcases provide additional capacity for extended holidays and international travel.

**What is the difference between hard and soft suitcases?**

Hard suitcases are designed to provide added protection for belongings and are a popular choice for air travel. Soft suitcases can offer greater flexibility and external storage options, depending on your travel needs.

**Are lightweight suitcases worth buying?**

Lightweight suitcases can make travelling easier by reducing overall luggage weight and helping maximise airline baggage allowances. Many lightweight styles are designed to balance durability with ease of movement.

**Which suitcase brands are available at David Jones?**

David Jones offers premium luggage from trusted brands including Samsonite, Antler and Delsey, known for quality materials, innovative features and reliable travel performance.

**How do I choose the best suitcase for international travel?**

When purchasing luggage for international travel, consider size, weight, packing capacity, durability and ease of manoeuvrability. Features such as spinner wheels, expandable storage and secure locking systems can help enhance your travel experience.

**What features should I look for when buying a suitcase?**

Popular features include lightweight construction, hard-shell protection, expandable compartments, organised packing sections, spinner wheels and secure locks. The ideal combination of features will depend on your travel habits and destination requirements.

**Can a suitcase be used as carry-on luggage?**

Many suitcases are designed to meet cabin baggage requirements and may be suitable for carry-on travel. Airline size and weight restrictions can vary, so it's important to check the requirements of your airline before travelling.

**What travel accessories pair well with suitcases?**

Travel accessories such as packing cubes, organisers, luggage tags and travel adapters can help improve organisation and make packing more efficient. Explore our range of **Travel Accessories** to complete your travel setup.
